title: Run comparison
description: Compares two test runs (JMeter and/or sitespeed.io) by run id. The time range only limits which runs are listed.

list.name: baseline
list.label: Baseline run
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "test_runs" WITH KEY = "runId" WHERE $timeFilter
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "test_runs" WITH KEY = "runId" WHERE $timeFilter

list.name: candidate
list.label: Candidate run
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "test_runs" WITH KEY = "runId" WHERE $timeFilter
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "test_runs" WITH KEY = "runId" WHERE $timeFilter

targets.query: SELECT mean("avg") FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND "runId" = '$baseline' AND $timeFilter
SELECT mean("avg") FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND "runId" = '$candidate' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: 95th percentile

targets.query: SELECT mean("pct95.0") FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND "runId" = '$baseline' AND $timeFilter
SELECT mean("pct95.0") FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND "runId" = '$candidate' AND $timeFilter

panels.description: Average of the p95 values JMeter reports every 5 s.

panels.title: Throughput

targets.query: SELECT sum("count") / (count("count") * 5) FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND "runId" = '$baseline' AND $timeFilter
SELECT sum("count") / (count("count") * 5) FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND "runId" = '$candidate' AND $timeFilter

panels.description: Requests per second over the run (samples / reporting time).

targets.query: SELECT sum("countError") / sum("count") * 100 FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND "runId" = '$baseline' AND $timeFilter
SELECT sum("countError") / sum("count") * 100 FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND "runId" = '$candidate' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Average response time over the run
panels.description: Both runs on one axis: x = seconds since the run's first 10 s bucket with data, so runs started at different times line up.

targets.query: SELECT mean("avg") FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND "runId" = '$baseline' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(10s) fill(none)
SELECT mean("avg") FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND "runId" = '$candidate' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(10s) fill(none)

panels.title: Throughput over the run
panels.description: Both runs on one axis: x = seconds since the run's first 10 s bucket with data, so runs started at different times line up.

targets.query: SELECT sum("count") / 10 FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND "runId" = '$baseline' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(10s) fill(none)
SELECT sum("count") / 10 FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND "runId" = '$candidate' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(10s) fill(none)

panels.title: Error rate over the run
panels.description: Both runs on one axis: x = seconds since the run's first 10 s bucket with data, so runs started at different times line up.

targets.query: SELECT sum("countError") / sum("count") * 100 FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND "runId" = '$baseline' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(10s) fill(none)
SELECT sum("countError") / sum("count") * 100 FROM "jmeter" WHERE "transaction" = 'all' AND "statut" = 'all' AND "runId" = '$candidate' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(10s) fill(none)

panels.title: Transactions: baseline vs candidate

targets.query: SELECT sum("count") AS "Samples (base)", mean("avg") AS "Avg (base)", mean("pct95.0") AS "p95 (base)" FROM "jmeter" WHERE "statut" = 'all' AND "transaction" !~ /^(all|internal)$/ AND "runId" = '$baseline' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "transaction"

SELECT sum("count") AS "Samples (cand)", mean("avg") AS "Avg (cand)", mean("pct95.0") AS "p95 (cand)" FROM "jmeter" WHERE "statut" = 'all' AND "transaction" !~ /^(all|internal)$/ AND "runId" = '$candidate' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "transaction"
SELECT sum("count") AS "Errors (base)" FROM "jmeter" WHERE "statut" = 'ko' AND "runId" = '$baseline' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "transaction"
SELECT sum("count") AS "Errors (cand)" FROM "jmeter" WHERE "statut" = 'ko' AND "runId" = '$candidate' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "transaction"

panels.description: Positive Δ (red) = candidate slower than baseline. Errors are failed samples.

targets.query: SELECT mean("pct95.0") AS "Baseline" FROM "jmeter" WHERE "statut" = 'all' AND "transaction" !~ /^(all|internal)$/ AND "runId" = '$baseline' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "transaction"
SELECT mean("pct95.0") AS "Candidate" FROM "jmeter" WHERE "statut" = 'all' AND "transaction" !~ /^(all|internal)$/ AND "runId" = '$candidate' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "transaction"

value.title: Open the candidate's sitespeed.io page report

targets.query: SELECT median("largestContentfulPaint") AS "LCP (base)", median("firstContentfulPaint") AS "FCP (base)", median("ttfb") AS "TTFB (base)", median("speedIndex") AS "SI (base)", median("transferSize") AS "Size (base)" FROM "sitespeed" WHERE "runId" = '$baseline' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "page"

SELECT median("largestContentfulPaint") AS "LCP (cand)", median("firstContentfulPaint") AS "FCP (cand)", median("ttfb") AS "TTFB (cand)", median("speedIndex") AS "SI (cand)", median("transferSize") AS "Size (cand)", last("report") AS "report" FROM "sitespeed" WHERE "runId" = '$candidate' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "page"

panels.description: Medians per page. Positive Δ (red) = candidate slower. Click a page for the candidate's page report.

targets.query: SELECT "status", "title", "durationSec", "samples", "errorPct", "pages", "report" FROM "test_runs" WHERE ("runId" = '$baseline' OR "runId" = '$candidate') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "runId", "tool", "application"
